module_summary: SERV bit-serial PC controller: the PC is a 32-bit shift register; serial adders compute PC+4/2 and PC+offset with carry flops, and a mux selects trap, jump or sequential next PC.

anchors.name: o_ibus_adr
anchors.why: PC shift register driving instruction bus address; shifts in new_pc when enabled.

anchors.name: new_pc
anchors.why: Next-PC mux result: trap vector, jump target or PC+4.

anchors.name: pc_plus_4
anchors.why: Serial sequential-PC adder result feeding new_pc and o_rd.

anchors.name: pc_plus_offset_aligned
anchors.why: Aligned PC+offset adder result: jump target, AUIPC result, bad PC.

anchors.name: i_pc_en
anchors.why: Enables PC shift and carry register updates.

anchors.name: i_jump
anchors.why: Selects jump target versus PC+4 for new_pc.

anchors.name: i_trap
anchors.why: Selects CSR trap vector as next PC.

anchors.name: o_rd
anchors.why: Serial rd writeback data: PC+offset for U-type or PC+4 for JAL/JALR.

anchors.name: pc_plus_4_cy_r
anchors.why: Carry flop of bit-serial PC+4 adder held between bit cycles.

anchors.name: pc_plus_offset_cy_r
anchors.why: Carry flop of bit-serial PC+offset adder.

anchors.name: offset_b
anchors.why: Offset operand: immediate for U-type else buffered offset.

anchors.name: i_utype
anchors.why: Selects immediate offset and U-type rd result.

anchors.name: plus_4
anchors.why: Increment bits: 2 for compressed, 4 otherwise, injected at count bit.

anchors.name: o_bad_pc
anchors.why: Misaligned jump target reported to CSR for mtval.

groups.name: PC register
groups.description: Shift-register PC driving instruction bus, updated when pc_en.

groups.name: Sequential PC adder
groups.description: Bit-serial PC+4/PC+2 adder with carry flop.

groups.name: Offset adder
groups.description: Bit-serial PC-relative/immediate adder for jumps and AUIPC/LUI.

groups.name: Next-PC select
groups.description: Chooses trap, jump or sequential PC; forms rd result.
